_comment: Varnox Chat API. Pterodactyl injects the allocation as SERVER_PORT and the server reads it, so the panel's address works with no extra configuration. Egg variables are exported into the container environment, so DATABASE_URL and friends reach the app without appearing in the startup command.
name: Varnox Chat API
author: blacklorddev15
description:
The Varnox Chat backend: tRPC over Express, plus a Server-Sent Events channel for realtime delivery.

Installs from github.com/blacklorddev15/varnox-chat-web and builds the API bundle. Requires a PostgreSQL database - the connection string is a variable below.

Run ONE instance only: the event bus lives inside the process, so a second instance would deliver realtime events to nobody. Everything still works, it just falls back to polling.

Set BUILD_WEB to 1 to also export the web app, so this server renders the site as well as serving the API. It roughly doubles install time.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "==> Installing curl if the image lacks it"
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq
    apt-get install -y -qq curl
fi

echo "==> Downloading Varnox Chat"
curl -fsSL "https://codeload.github.com/blacklorddev15/varnox-chat-web/tar.gz/refs/heads/main" -o /tmp/varnox.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/varnox.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm -f /tmp/varnox.tar.gz

echo "==> Activating pnpm"
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@9.12.0 --activate

echo "==> Installing dependencies (several minutes)"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

echo "==> Building the API bundle"
pnpm build

if [ "${BUILD_WEB}" = "true" ] || [ "${BUILD_WEB}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "==> BUILD_WEB is on, exporting the web app as well"
    pnpm build:web:selfhost
fi

if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && [ ! -f node_modules/.bin/tsx ]; then
    echo "==> Warning: devDependencies look missing; the API build may be incomplete"
fi

echo "==> Applying database migrations"
if [ -n "${DATABASE_URL}" ]; then
    if ! pnpm db:migrate; then
        echo "!! Migration failed. The API will still start, but features needing newer tables stay switched off."
        echo "!! Re-run it from this server's console with: pnpm db:migrate"
    fi
else
    echo "!! DATABASE_URL is empty, so migrations were skipped. Set it and re-run the installer, or migrate from elsewhere."
fi

echo "==> Done. Press Start. The server listens on SERVER_PORT automatically."

variables.name: PostgreSQL connection string
variables.description:
The database the API uses. Include sslmode=require for hosted Postgres, e.g.
postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname?sslmode=require

variables.name: Session signing secret
variables.description: Signs session tokens. Use a long random string. Changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The first account, which gets admin rights.

variables.name: Resend API key
variables.description: For verification and password-reset email. Leave blank and those emails are logged instead of sent.

variables.name: Email sender
variables.description: Must be on a domain verified in Resend, or sends are rejected.

variables.name: Also build the web app
variables.description: 1 = export the frontend too, so this server renders the site at its address as well as serving the API. Leave 0 if the frontend is on Vercel.
